title: OR positive control: exact B2 complexity n-1 and coefficient 1

claims.statement: Let L be the set of finite binary strings containing at least one 1, with f_n its characteristic function on length n and f_0(empty)=0. This single total language is in P and hence NP via the fixed empty-witness verifier in proof.md. In the full Li–Yang B2 model specified in rules.md, C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for every integer n>=1. Consequently liminf_{n->infinity} C_B2(f_n)/n=1, establishing the declared coefficient 1.
